entries.title: Psalms 24:1
segments: ¶<<Of David. A Psalm.>> The earth is Jehovah's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

entries.title: Psalms 24:2
segments: For it was he that founded it upon seas, and established it upon floods.

entries.title: Psalms 24:3
segments: ¶Who shall ascend into the mount of Jehovah? and who shall stand in his holy place?

entries.title: Psalms 24:4
segments: He that hath blameless hands and a pure heart; who lifteth not up his soul unto vanity, nor sweareth deceitfully:

entries.title: Psalms 24:5
segments: He shall receive blessing from Jehovah, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 24:6
segments: This is the generation of them that seek unto him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 24:7
segments: ¶Lift up your heads, ye gates, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in.

entries.title: Psalms 24:8
segments: Who is this King of glory? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.

entries.title: Psalms 24:9
segments: Lift up your heads, ye gates; yea, lift up, ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in.

entries.title: Psalms 24:10
segments: Who is he, this King of glory? Jehovah of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
